rules: All seven fields are mandatory before each phase.
Authorized paths are a strict allowlist and phase declarations may only narrow.
Reuse P54 evidence and do not repeat identical failed requests without a new falsifiable reason.
Every outbound request must be recorded before the next request is made.
Every retained URL and stable video ID must be verified against an official TikTok public surface.
A technique failure triggers the next authorized strategy inside P57, not a new Queue or PR.

Any need for login, cookies, credentials, CAPTCHA/anti-bot bypass, paid service, protected-foundation edits, more than 40 new requests, production, scheduling or main authority stops for Human Decision.

resume_checkpoint.prohibited_replay: Do not repeat the same P54 public surface request merely to reproduce the same zero-identity outcome.

access_and_request_policy.raw_payload_storage: minimum sanitized fixture only; no secrets, tokens, cookies, request URLs or unnecessary personal data

instructions: Validate KU2D-SCOPE-000004 and the current phase declaration before every phase.
Reuse P54 evidence, start a cumulative ledger at historical requests 5, and do not replay identical failed calls.
Try the Strategy Ladder in order, recording why each transition is justified.
Prefer public search-index discovery followed by official TikTok oEmbed/embed verification of stable canonical URLs.
Retain no more than five valid records per topic and verify the final set in two bounded live rounds.
After live proof, sanitize fixtures and use fixture replay for all remaining tests.
Create a thin source-specific adapter/parser/mapper and immutable Registry V3 without editing V1/V2 or shared validators/runner/workflow.
Run targeted, integration, MTC, invariant and exact-head full-corpus tests; use one PR and squash merge only when all required gates pass.
Submit only KU2D-R-000058 with strategy outcomes, exact ledger, records by topic, repeated-live proof, MTC, registry lineage, fixture/evidence hashes, scope diff, CJ7, PR/CI/tree and limitations.
stop_conditions: login, cookies, credentials, user authorization or provider approval is required
CAPTCHA, anti-bot, access-control or policy bypass is required
paid scraping/proxy service or spending is required
more than 40 new outbound requests is required
a protected shared runner, validator, V1/V2 registry/manifest/schema or CI workflow must change
a retained URL cannot be verified on an official TikTok public surface
production write, recurring scheduling or main modification is required
definition_of_done: all entered phases have valid seven-field declarations
five valid records per topic are retained with stable video IDs and canonical URLs
every retained URL is verified on an official TikTok public surface
two bounded live retrieval rounds reproduce the valid final set
request ledger, deduplication and record caps are exact
thin TikTok adapter, sanitized fixture, capability/source/run manifests and Registry V3 are complete
V1/V2 and shared foundation invariants remain unchanged
fixture replay, MTC, early quality gate, exact-head corpus and Data Acquisition CI pass
KU2D-CJ-000007 closes with no pending links
one green PR squash-merges to integration and post-merge verification passes
